summary.headline: A slow-dying Korean Nexa group: price despair, mining-vs-buying advice, wallet headaches, and two flare-ups
summary.summary: This window spans roughly two and a half years (Nov 2023 – Apr 2026) in a very low-traffic Korean group, so conversations are short bursts separated by weeks or months. Early on 바 맨 and PLUS W chat about whether Nexa has bottomed, compare other mining coins (Qubic, Firo) and decide to just hold into spring, while 바 맨 says he's done with mining coins entirely. Practical questions recur: 책사 여왕벌 on changing deposit addresses in the Otoplo wallet, GD Y on mining payouts and the xeggex exchange, and 경재 신 reporting that Coinone rejected his Nexa transfer as 'concealed funds'. Sentiment splits between 보물 신's very bullish long-term calls (100x by 2026, 1,000x by 2027) and HAYAN LEXUS's skepticism, which escalated into a spat with Shon Parker that ended with HAYAN LEXUS declaring the Korean group useless and leaving. A separate English-language troll (user 7395312124) spammed 'scammers/rug' accusations and Kaspa praise, answered calmly by endo; much later endo confirms the group has no active admins and that the Nexa team held a conference in Korea and hopes the Korean community revives. The final messages are link drops, a 2026 market-status post, and Russian spam.

topics.title: Price outlook and holding Nexa
topics.summary: PLUS W and 바 맨 hoped for a bounce and decided to hold into spring; 보물 신 repeatedly pushed a long-term thesis (supply >90% mined by end-2026, 100x by 2026, 1,000x by 2027, '$1'), while Shon Parker joked about becoming a whale and HAYAN LEXUS challenged the basis for such confidence and later asked whether it was worth buying after the long decline.

topics.title: Mining vs. buying (DCA)
topics.summary: 바 맨 said he's giving up on mining coins and teased a new one; PLUS W asked about Qubic and Firo; GD Y considered running a low-power miner, and kazya Lee advised that DCA-buying on crashes beat mining after electricity costs.

topics.title: Wallets, exchanges and deposit problems
topics.summary: 책사 여왕벌 asked why the Otoplo wallet keeps generating new deposit addresses; 경재 신 reported Nexa deposits being suspended and a Coinone transfer rejected as 'concealed funds', asking how others move coins from foreign exchanges into Korea; GD Y asked about xeggex and kazya Lee recommended MEXC instead.

topics.title: Clash over 'obvious' questions
topics.summary: HAYAN LEXUS asked whether Nexa is truly decentralized or whether the team could alter/shut the code; Shon Parker told him to study first, and HAYAN LEXUS left saying the official English group answered him kindly (≈29% mined, code can't be tampered with) and that the Korean group is useless.

topics.title: English-language troll attack
topics.summary: user 7395312124 spammed accusations that Nexa is a scam, a '2 years failure' with new ATLs and a 'rug V2.0' roadmap, praising Kaspa as king of L1 PoW; endo replied calmly and refused to engage further.

topics.title: Group inactivity and team presence
topics.summary: HAYAN LEXUS asked whether the room was dead and called for 'survivors'; jQrgen said hello and endo explained the Nexa team has no active admins here, that the group was community-made, and that a recent conference in Korea went well and they hope the Korean community revives.

topics.title: News, promos and link drops
topics.summary: 책사 여왕벌 posted the Bitget Earn 20% APR listing, a Naver news article about someone secretly mining Nexa, blog links and a March 2026 market update (≈12–14% weekly drop blamed on Israel–Iran conflict, ~$5.13M market cap, volume up 25%); 보물 신 promoted a new Korean Nexa Naver cafe.

topics.title: Off-topic and spam
topics.summary: 바 맨 joked about riding Grok instead, PLUS W asked for its spelling, and the window closes with a Russian promotional spam message.

summary.mood_description: The baseline is weary: a handful of holders checking whether the bottom is in, some bursts of optimism from 보물 신 and playful whale jokes from Shon Parker, but mostly long silences and complaints like 'there's just no hope' and 'it's dead, guess I should sell'. Two sharp negative spikes stand out — the Shon Parker vs HAYAN LEXUS argument that drove a member out, and the English troll's scam accusations. A brief positive lift comes in late 2025 when endo from the Nexa team appears, mentions a Korea conference and asks for the community to revive, but the group quickly lapses back into solo link drops and spam.

highlights.why: A member publicly quits, saying the official English group answered his questions (29% mined, code can't be changed) while the Korean group is 'completely useless' — a clear community-health signal.
Nexa team member endo confirms the group has no active admins, that it was community-created, and mentions a recent conference in Korea.
보물 신's headline bull call — all-time low now, 100x by 2026, 1,000x by 2027 — which later triggers pushback.
Concrete, actionable problem: a Nexa withdrawal to Coinone was rejected as 'concealed funds', with the user asking how others get coins into Korean exchanges.
kazya Lee's practical advice from experience: after electricity costs, DCA-buying on dips beat mining.
Peak of the troll rant — calls the 24-25 roadmap 'the New rug V2.0' after alleged 2022/2023 failures; shows the criticism the project faces.
